notes.title: Important update: New sports mode and improved camera display
notes.content:
[h1]Important updates:[/h1]
[h3]1. Add sports mode - In this mode, players need to constantly swing their arms to make the game character run.
Check the "Sports Mode" option at the beginning of the game to activate the game's sports mode.
In sports mode, players must constantly swing their arms to make the game character run. The faster the swing speed, the faster the game character runs. If the player stops moving, the character will maintain a walking state.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781459/b3e5bc49912bdd1cfcb9b3a57c2d395bb4634847.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781459/5f081b09df4047527da779a0473669b0d507dfdf.gif[/img]
[h3]2. The camera captures images embedded in the game screen, allowing players to see their actions in real-time.
The captured image of the camera no longer appears as a separate window, but is embedded in real-time game graphics.
The transparency of the screen can be adjusted in the game settings.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781459/13f1034345b9efc17a6f648c2299472536b1ebf7.png[/img]
[h3]3. Add a new capture action - kick action.
Lifting one leg towards the front of the screen can trigger a kicking action.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781459/ca674932d42d63fdfea0697ba24f3d54b4d29083.gif[/img]
